summary: Fixed the build for rustc 1.63 by setting rust-version to 1.63, replacing let-else, and pinning fieldsplit to 0.4.1 through the mirror with a re-vendored vendor/ and updated Cargo.lock. Also fixed the features and the version, added remapped paths for reproducible builds, made build.rs rerun when sites.csv changes, and made every tests/ file run; make test, the core-only build, the no-default-features build and the reproducibility, site-table and version checks all pass.
